Title: Is a Prince neccesary? (LSJ or someone from WW)

Messages.Author: Kevin Masterson
Messages.Body:
Hello everyone, but mostly LSJ or whoever is somewhat official.

We in the Chicagoland area no longer have a Prince (that position used
to be held by yours truly). And we where wondering if a Prince is
really needed to hold tourneys. Mostly for the fact that no one else
want's to be the Prince and so we won't be having one for the
forseeable future. We have 2-3 stores that carry the product and would
be able to hold them at, but some people worry about the sanctioning
and points. Hey I just want to be able to play.

Thanx in advance.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:

Not necessary at all.
See the guide to running tournaments online.

A Prince would be benficial, though, to keep the community "in-the-loop"
as far as special tournaments and similar are concerned (pre-release

Messages.Author: Carl Pilhatsch
Messages.Body:
umbr...@rocketmail.com (Kevin Masterson) wrote in message news:<96dcffb8.01122...@posting.google.com>...


You can always play without a Prince. However, if you want to be in
touch with the large community of other players worldwide, it would be
beneficial to have a VEKN Prince. A Prince is not someone who "rules"
over other players in his city, no he is more or less responsible for
making it easy for new players to get into the game, to pass news from
the "Conclave" to his players, applying for pre-release events,
regional qualifier events, etc.
A Prince usually voices the opinions of his players to the "powers
that be", if asked to do so (which happens quite often with WW).
A Prince can be a valuable addition to a city's playgroups, he can
organise things, and bring in new players as he acts as a focal point,
and get better support in doing so from WW.

I encourage all players feeling the urge to do something in helping
VTES grow around the globe to step forward and e-mail me at
carl.pi...@chello.at so you can become VEKN Prince. See the
Prince-List on the WW HP for vacant positions, or if your city is not
listed at all, then by all means go for it! :)
Please note: a new update is imminent, so some cities might already be
with a Prince again.

Carl Pilhatsch
(VEKN membership director)
